name: @tatami/host-desktop
description: Tatami Pass Host — app de escritorio (Mac y Windows) que ejecuta el host sin Docker ni terminal
author: Tatami Pass

scripts.build: tsc -b tsconfig.json tsconfig.preload.json tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer.json
scripts.dev: node scripts/build-deps.mjs && npm run build && electron .
scripts.prepare:dist: node scripts/build-deps.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/fetch-native.mjs && node scripts/fetch-caddy.mjs --soft && node scripts/make-icons.mjs
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare:dist && node scripts/fetch-native.mjs --target linux-x64 && node scripts/fetch-caddy.mjs --soft --target linux-x64 && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:dist && node scripts/fetch-native.mjs --target mac-arm64,mac-x64 && node scripts/fetch-caddy.mjs --soft --target mac-arm64,mac-x64 && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare:dist && node scripts/fetch-native.mjs --target win-x64 && node scripts/fetch-caddy.mjs --soft --target win-x64 && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:all: npm run prepare:dist && node scripts/fetch-native.mjs --all && node scripts/fetch-caddy.mjs --soft --all && electron-builder -mwl
scripts.dist:win:zip: npm run prepare:dist && node scripts/fetch-native.mjs --target win-x64 && node scripts/fetch-caddy.mjs --soft --target win-x64 && electron-builder --win portable zip
